Results.ReviewText:
I have owned this grill for 4 1/2 years, and it has been used 2-3 times weekly for 8 months of the year.  It is well-built and it just works.  I have a good amount of space for cooking for a large family and I cook a wide variety of foods, including pizza, on the grill.  The sides tables are convenient for counter space, with hooks for hanging utensils and are easy to clean. I've been really pleased with the grill and it held up well.  The grill has been worth the cost and I will be buying another Weber product whenever that time comes.  

After about 4 years, I found the flavorizer bars had deteriorated and the burners and manifold were looking like they would be breaking down as well.  These needed to be fixed. Weber has replaced these under the grill's warranty and the parts were easily removed and replaced.  No other grill I have ever owned has had such a warranty for these parts or similar.  Weber stands behind their products and with their customers.  Thanks Weber!
Results.Title: Great Quality Grill and Warranty/Customer Support

Results.ReviewText: We purchased our Weber grill over 2 years ago. We made the purchase after owning 3 grills prior to the Weber. We've had to replace our grills every couple of years. We live in the city and do not have a place to store a grill through the winter. Our grills have had to stay outside covered but still in the elements of some cold and snowy Boston winters and unfortunately, they just weren't up for the job! After replacing them a few times we knew it was time to invest in the best! We've been able to leave our Weber out on our deck, covered with a Weber cover. It looks as good today as the day we purchased it! We have been beyond thrilled with our Weber and even encouraged our neighbors to purchase one too!
Results.Title: Invest In The Best!

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
